meta.name: genomic-coordinates
meta.description: Convert genomic intervals between coordinate conventions, normalise and compare variant representations, and detect assembly or contig-naming mismatches before they corrupt an analysis. Use whenever coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary - converting between BED, GFF/GTF, VCF, SAM/BAM, WIG, PSL, genePred, Picard interval_list, or region strings; reconciling 0-based half-open with 1-based inclusive; left-aligning or trimming indels; checking whether two variant records describe the same change; mapping genomic to transcript, CDS, or protein positions; auditing a BED/GTF/VCF for convention violations; or diagnosing GRCh37 vs hg19 vs GRCh38 vs T2T, chr-prefix, and liftover problems. Triggers include "off by one", "0-based", "1-based", "half-open", "coordinate system", "left-align", "normalize variant", "bcftools norm", "chr prefix", "wrong genome build", "liftover", "REF mismatch", and "HGVS".

copy.tagline_en: Convert genomic intervals between coordinate conventions and genome assemblies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with coordinates from different tools or genome builds

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在基因组坐标任务中调用脚本:把坐标在 BED、GFF、VCF 等格式间转换,按参考基因组标准化并比较变异,检查文件格式是否符合规范、参考基因组版本是否匹配,并报告结果。
howto.when: 当坐标跨了格式、工具或基因组版本边界时触发——比如你说到 “0-based”、“liftover”、“chr 前缀”等术语,或要求转换 BED/VCF 坐标、标准化变异、检查基因组构建。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses scripts to convert coordinates between BED/GFF/VCF etc., normalise and compare variants against a reference, audit files for format violations, and check genome-build compatibility.
howto.when_en: Triggered when coordinates cross a format, tool or assembly boundary: mention '0-based', 'liftover', 'chr prefix', or ask to convert BED/VCF coordinates, normalise variants, or check genome build.

say_en.text: Convert BED coordinates chr1:999-1000 to GFF format.
Normalise variant chr1:7:CAC:C using reference ref.fa.
Check if this VCF and GTF use the same genome build.
